scope: Twelve-resident town, dedicated Haru JRPG model, walking/conversation/work/food/sleep/waking and eye controls. Saki/Tomo/Yui model renewal remains in development.

packaged_smoke.scope: Actual bundled PCK loaded by matching Godot 4.7.2, external verification script. Native app launch is checked separately; does not invoke save/load.

native_launch: Opened the exported .app through macOS, started a new town, selected Haru from the roster, followed him, paused/resumed and observed natural conversation. Left open and paused. Agent-operated verification; not human playtesting.
post_verification_cleanup: After delivery, the verification app was closed at the user request to reduce load. The archive and extracted app remain available.
